messages.author: 5b9f4c138fd9a813
messages.subject: Phylomorphospace plot error
parts:
Hello geomorph community,

I am trying to use the gm.prcomp function as described in the "Principal components analysis and visualization tools for exploring shape space", with no success.

I have a tree with 21 taxa in the newick format, I have read it with read.tree from ape. Also, I calculated my species means to run this analysis:

subset_coords_spe <- coords.subset(A = lm_data_pa$coords,
                               group = class$Species)
names(subset_coords_spe)
spmean <- lapply(subset_coords_spe, mshape)
spmean <- simplify2array(spmean, higher = TRUE)

r <- read.tree("tree.newick")
gm.prcomp(spmean, phy = r)

this is the error that I get: Error in Y[phy$tip.label, ] : índice fora de limites (index out of bounds, in english)

All the names of labels match, so I'm not sure of what might be causing this problem.

Thanks in advance,

--
Diniz Ferreira
Graduando em Ciências Biológicas
Laboratório de Evolução e Genética de Insetos (LEGIN)
DEZG - IB - Universidade Federal de Pelotas

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Phylomorphospace plot error
parts:
Diniz,

You might think the names match but R doesn’t seem to agree.

Have you verified an exact match?  Try the match function or try:

unique(c(names(subset_coords_spe), r$tip.label))

and see if a name seems to appear twice, maybe because of an extra space or some other character in one of the names.

Best,
Mike
